item.title: Tony Greaves: Why I am A Liberal Democrat
item.description: Tony Greaves (Lord Greaves) died on 23 March 2021. He was a Liberal legend. The Liberal Party, and the Liberal Democrats, owe an enormous amount to his commitment and drive, in local campaigning, in the House of Lords, and in the development of the party’s policy and ideology. item.title: Remembering Shirley Williams
item.description: We were saddened to hear of the death of Shirley Williams on 12 April 2021. Shirley played a key role in the foundation of the SDP and of the Liberal Democrats, led the Liberal Democrats in the Lords from 2001 to 2004, and remained active in the Lords and the party until her retirement in […]

item.title: Lord Tony Greaves (27 July 1942 – 23 March 2021)
item.description: by Michael Meadowcroft Tony Greaves never seemed to age. He had a firm belief that politics was capable of transforming society, and his consistent advocacy of local campaigning, community politics and the necessity for both to be anchored in a radical Liberalism had hardly changed from his Young Liberal days. item.title: Eleanor Acland – a neglected Liberal activist
item.description: By Paul Auchterlonie Eleanor Acland was born Eleanor Margaret Cropper in Westmoreland in 1878, into a family with political connections.
